payload.summary: PhysicsLabStudioDiagnostics publishes WorldId, RegionId, resolved fingerprint, and repro identity directly from mutable lab-model attributes without proving those physical-view attributes still match canonical recipe/resolved truth.
payload.impact: A Studio/plugin/test mutation can change one or more root identity attributes while leaving runtime WorldEntity truth unchanged; standalone diagnostics capture and enable can then return/JSON-print forged evidence identity, and enable uses the same unchecked fingerprint/repro values in visual readout labels. Workspace would effectively become trusted evidence authority for those fields.
sourceProof: main@ae83c0ef470eb2e73d99be41fd3561ede30c40e1 PhysicsLabStudioDiagnostics.capture() uses requireStringAttribute(model, UNRENDERED_WorldId/RegionId/ResolvedRegionFingerprint/ResolvedRegionReproKey) and checks only non-empty string type
PhysicsLabStudioDiagnostics.enable() preflights fingerprint/repro with the same type-only helper before constructing labels

main PhysicsLabValidation.assertCanonicalRootIdentity() already derives canonical PhysicsLabRecipe/ResolvedRegionRecipe truth and compares these exact root attributes, but that validator is private to the validation collector and diagnostics does not invoke an equivalent canonical-root identity boundary
Docs/PHYSICS_LAB_DIAGNOSTICS.md requires machine-readable diagnostics to agree with production truth and treats visual labels as diagnostic representation only
payload.sourceLevelRepro: Realize the canonical lab, mutate lab.model:SetAttribute('UNRENDERED_WorldId', 'world:v1:forged') (or RegionId/fingerprint/repro) without touching runtime records, then call PhysicsLabStudioDiagnostics.capture(lab). By source inspection the forged non-empty string is returned in the snapshot; no Studio execution is claimed.
payload.nonDuplicate: Existing diagnostics blockers own representation-set completeness, exact (entityId,candidateInstance) representation binding, readout-tree one-to-one completeness, and cycle/final-snapshot tests. Repository PR search found no diagnostics root-truth binding repair; #221 hardens the separate PhysicsLabValidation collector, not Diagnostics.capture/enable.
recommendedClosure: bind diagnostics root identity to project-owned canonical/runtime truth before capture returns or enable renders labels
do not treat mutable Workspace attributes alone as authority
prefer a narrow reusable canonical-root identity seam or equivalent bounded comparison rather than duplicating a second truth model
add source/pure regression proving tampered WorldId, RegionId, fingerprint, and repro attributes fail closed before evidence publication
preserve diagnostics failure atomicity and do not convert source closure into Studio viewport PASS
